description: Canonical capability vocabulary for the tunnelmind:crew_ops:v1 profile. An AIT's `capabilities` array MUST draw only from these tokens. The witness rejects an AIT declaring a capability outside this set.

capabilities.crew_ops:autonomy_decide: Decide, under the autonomy rails, whether an agent may take a Class 1-3 action, and record grants, expiries and requests.
capabilities.crew_ops:ratify: Record the owner's approved or rejected decision on a request the rails sent for ratification.
capabilities.crew_ops:intake_decide: Decide whether an idea from the thinker or the scout is acted on, parked or dropped, and where it is routed.
capabilities.crew_ops:owner_command: Record a command the owner gave the crew, by mail or at the CLI, and its outcome.
